text: Heap explainer (concepts/heap/heap-explorer.html) is unreadable: nodes and array cells are solid black with black text, through the app and from disk. The file is a fragment that expects a host page's colour variables (--foreground, --muted) and has no doctype, title or viewport. Seen in the browser test run of 2026-11-16.

Arrays & Hashing explainer opens at section 3, not the top: the doubling prediction gate focuses its first button when it renders on load (box.querySelector('button').focus(), about line 400). Same through the app and from disk.

Explainers are served sandboxed by the app, so localStorage throws; references/explainers.md doesn't say so, and tests/browser/check_app.py uses a placeholder explainer, so it passed while the Arrays & Hashing stepper was dead. That page was fixed in 78b3214 (blocked a session); the guide and the check are unchanged.

Improve it: feedback typed into 'What should change?' is wiped when the tab regains focus, because the visibilitychange reload redraws the Learn page (it only skips while the handoff is open). The hint under the box tells him to attempt a problem first, which is what triggers it.
The 'Ask your coach' handoff panel stays open across views: it followed to Today, covered half the Due list with a stale prompt, and while it is open the page doesn't reload itself on return.

Today shows a stale live solve as current: 'block 10: 15 of 15 min' for contains-duplicate, untouched for 6 days, with no age and no prompt to resume, park or drop it. The session-start hook says all three; the page has last_active and doesn't use it.
Today's Due list is 17 equal rows: it doesn't mark the three for today (REVIEWS_PER_DAY), shows slugs where the Learn page shows titles, and repeats contains-duplicate, which is also the live solve.

Scroll isn't reset between views. At side-panel width, opening a pattern from low on the one-column map lands with the title and explainer button above the viewport, and '← Map' returns to the top of the map. Likewise the server-offline notice is out of view if he presses Refresh while scrolled, so nothing seems to happen.

Smaller things from the browser test run: the panel hides the 'Next re-solve' column but keeps Status; the map says 'Blind 75 1/8' for Arrays & Hashing beside eight rows marked 'last: solved'; quotes in Improve-it feedback appear escaped in the prompt (JSON.stringify); the tab title is 'DSA Coach' on every view; Cmd+Enter doesn't submit the feedback form.
